Description

The Steel Chisel is a second-tier chisel, being sold on the shelf near the entrance of The Oak Depot for $2,000.

Chisels are tools used to slice refined and forged ores or rocks into smaller pieces and shave down raw rocks to fit into refineries and forges. Do note that chiseling raw rocks will reduce their value, so it is advised to save them to be processed in a larger machine later.

Appearance

The Steel Chisel, as its name implies, is a typical-looking chisel made of steel. Its handle is made of the same wood type other steel tools use for their handles, that being the default legacy wood material. The blade is gray in color with the default legacy metal material applied to it.

Trivia

  • Chisels are the only tools that do not have their statistics listed in their descriptions, presumably because the only way different-tier chisels differ is the speed at which they slice.
